thread:
Jordan (CSM): FYI BrightMap reported a spike hitting their onboarding flows. They said it interrupted a renewal demo. Need evidence + credit calc before the 15:00 sync.
Priya (AM): thanks — can we get a crisp one-pager? customer wants impact, why, and remediation.
Kai (SRE): quick diagnostic: autoscaler oscillation + cold prefix cache misses. Ran query: `SELECT percentile(p95_latency_ms, 95) as p95, count(*) as reqs FROM request_logs WHERE customer='brightmap' AND route='/v1/embeddings' AND ts BETWEEN '2026-03-20T14:00:00Z' AND '2026-03-20T14:20:00Z'` — p95 ~520ms for ~12 minutes, baseline ~80ms.
Jordan (CSM): dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/d/boards/brightmap-onboard?p=embed_p95 — will attach sample request ids and traces.
Liam (Eng): probable cause: rapid scale-down then immediate scale-up. Warmup path didn't complete. Short-term: raise min replicas for onboarding pool for this customer; enable prefix-warm cache. Long-term: add autoscaler hysteresis.
Priya (AM): what's our policy threshold for issuing credits? Ops/legal want a clear calc.
Kai (SRE): policy: if >10% of requests in a billing window exceed latency SLO for >10m, generate credit calc. I'll snapshot the offending window and export traces.
Jordan (CSM): initial exposure calc (token-weighted): ~3% of monthly bill for the window. If we offer an immediate goodwill plus remediation plan we can de-escalate renewal risk.
Priya (AM): recommend we offer 4% one-time credit and a follow-up enablement session. Cheaper to keep renewal.
Liam (Eng): engineering can commit to roll warmup toggle to onboarding pools tonight and autoscaler smoothing in two weeks. Fine with 4%.
Kai (SRE): uploading evidence bundle to s3://redwood-evidence/brightmap/2026-03-20/ — will include traces, raw query output, and aggregated p95 graphs. Signed bundle link once ready.
ops-bot: Incident INC-20260320-72 created (priority: P2). Owner: Kai (SRE).
Jordan (CSM): action items: 1) Kai: evidence bundle + credit calc by 14:40 2) Liam: deploy warmup toggle to onboarding pools by EOD today 3) Priya: draft comms & confirm credit (aim for 4%) 4) Jordan: prep one-pager for customer call.
Priya (AM): will draft comms now. language: "we've applied a one-time credit of 4% for the impacted billing period and scheduled infrastructure improvements to avoid recurrence." will flag renewal risk to amber.
Jordan (CSM): I'll post draft here for signoff at 14:50. thanks team :thumbsup:
Kai (SRE): evidence bundle upload started; ETA 6m. I'll also attach sample spans in the bundle and the autoscaler event timeline.
Jordan (CSM): noted — will include evidence link in the CSM one-pager and route to legal for approval if needed.
Priya (AM): if legal pushes back, propose 3% + extended trial credits. but we'll try 4% first.
Liam (Eng): logging a small follow-up ticket to measure prefix-warm hit-rate post-toggle.
Jordan (CSM): closing loop — will post final comms and credit calc here before the call.
